scripts.check: npm run check:tokens && npm run check --workspaces --if-present && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json
scripts.test: tsx --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/foundation.test.ts tests/schema.test.ts tests/homepage.test.ts tests/static-output.test.ts tests/editorial.test.ts
scripts.build: npm run check:tokens && npm run build --workspace @formelo/web && node scripts/check-built-site.mjs
scripts.verify: npm run check:runtime && npm run check && npm test && npm run build && npm run test:browser
